description: Source code file implementing schedule management functions and data structures, including day translation, schedule status evaluation, and CRUD operations for schedule objects and parameters.

methods.name: int dayname_to_week_day(const char * day)
methods.description: Converts a day name string to a corresponding weekday number (Sunday=0, Monday=1, ...).

methods.name: char * get_status(char * start,char * period,char * day)
methods.description: Determines the schedule status ('Active', 'Inactive', 'Error', or 'StackDisabled') based on current time, day, start time, and duration.

methods.name: int addSchedule(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char ** instance)
methods.description: Creates a new schedule section with default values and associates it with an instance.

methods.name: int delSchedule(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,unsigned char del_action)
methods.description: Deletes schedule sections linked to the given instance.

methods.name: int browseScheduleInstance(struct dmctx * dmctx,DMNODE * parent_node,void * prev_data,char * prev_instance)
methods.description: Enumerates schedule instances, linking each with its corresponding object in the management framework.

methods.name: int get_schedules_enable(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves whether scheduling is globally enabled.

methods.name: int set_schedules_enable(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets the global enable/disable flag for schedules.

methods.name: int get_schedule_number(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Returns the total number of schedule entries.

methods.name: int get_schedule_enable(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the enable status of a specific schedule.

methods.name: int set_schedule_enable(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets the enable status of a specific schedule.

methods.name: int get_schedule_alias(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Gets the alias (name) of a schedule.

methods.name: int set_schedule_alias(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets the alias (name) of a schedule, involving renaming section if valid.

methods.name: int get_schedule_desc(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a schedule.

methods.name: int set_schedule_desc(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets the description of a schedule.

methods.name: int get_schedule_day(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Gets the days associated with a schedule as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: int set_schedule_day(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets the days for a schedule from a comma-separated string, validating allowed days.

methods.name: int get_schedule_start(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the start time of a schedule.

methods.name: int set_schedule_start(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets the start time of a schedule, validating format HH:MM.

methods.name: int get_schedule_duration(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the duration of the schedule.

methods.name: int set_schedule_duration(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char * value,int action)
methods.description: Sets the duration of the schedule, validating that it is a positive unsigned integer.

methods.name: int get_schedule_status(char * refparam,struct dmctx * ctx,void * data,char * instance,char ** value)
methods.description: Determines the current status of a schedule ('Active', 'Inactive', 'StackDisabled', or 'Inactive') based on current time and configuration.
